description: Generate a single pixel art sprite. Handles prompt engineering, generation via Gemini, and post-processing (crop, background removal, pixelation downscale, square padding) automatically. Returns a clean, transparent PNG at proper pixel art resolution. Output size snaps to standard pixel art sizes (16, 24, 32, 48, 64, 96, 128).

background.description: Background color for generation. Use "auto" to pick based on description. Use "chromakey" for best transparency (HSV-based green screen removal). Named colors: chromakey, forest, sky, dungeon, lava, ocean, sand, snow, night. (default: black)

description.description: What the sprite is (e.g. "green slime enemy with horns", "cyan spaceship", "golden coin")

model.description: Model alias or full ID. Aliases: 25, nano-banana, banana, banana-2, nano-banana-2, gemini-flash, flash, gemini-pro, pro, gemini-25, gemini-flash-25 (default: nano-banana)

references.description: Paths to existing PNG/JPEG assets to match visual style.

size.description: Target sprite size in pixels (default: 48). Snaps to nearest standard size. Recommended: 16-24 for icons/projectiles/powerups, 32 for tiles/small sprites, 48 for game sprites/characters (PixelLab default), 64 for detailed characters, 96-128 for bosses/large objects. Set to 0 to skip downscale.

name: forge_sprite
